contests.title: South Kingstown town — Question 6: Police rules without council approval
contests.scopeNote: Municipal electorate named in the official sample ballot; exact held Census county subdivision, excluding similarly named CDPs and school districts.

provenance.quote: Shall Sec. 4414.4 of the Town Charter be amended to provide that the Chief of Police may issue rules and regulations for the conduct of all members of the Police Department without being required to receive Town Council approval for such rules and regulations?

measures.questionText: Shall Sec. 4414.4 of the Town Charter be amended to provide that the Chief of Police may issue rules and regulations for the conduct of all members of the Police Department without being required to receive Town Council approval for such rules and regulations?

provenance.quote: Shall Sec. 4414.4 of the Town Charter be amended to provide that the Chief of Police may issue rules and regulations for the conduct of all members of the Police Department without being required to receive Town Council approval for such rules and regulations?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow the police chief to issue rules and regulations governing all Police Department members without Town Council approval.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve removing the council-approval requirement for those police rules.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the Town Council approval requirement.
